label: copy phase: echoed g when the next output is m (g-m bigram, recall index >= 3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, nearly always (96% of mass) when the fed-back input is g, with a weak tail on input m (4%). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or at recall_idx <= 2. Strongest when g is followed by m in the original, so the model is about to output m: g->m with recall_idx >= 3 has 86% precision and holds 71% of the mass, and covers 89% of the top activation quartile. Every top example is a g m bigram copied at recall 3-6. Weaker activations (mostly below 0.3 of max) occur on echoed g with other outputs (i, g, h, digits...), but only ~5% of copy-phase g inputs fire at all, so g alone is very imprecise (F1 0.10). Longer sequences (L = 8-9) give higher rates.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=g (+7.37), in_tok=g (+4.76), phase=2 & out_tok=m (+3.93), phase=2 & in_tok=m (+3.80), out_tok=m (+3.72), in_tok=m (+3.24). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.02), recall_idx=1 (-3.26), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.26), recall_idx=2 (-2.45).
